i.norm: Verifies that countArgs counts each character between the parentheses of a non-standard descriptor string. The input is not a valid Java method descriptor; it happens to contain '(' and ')' so countArgs treats all characters between them as individual argument tokens (none trigger the L…; object-reference or [ array-prefix rules), yielding a count of 52.
A free-form string that contains '(' and ')' but no valid JVM type characters
All 52 characters between the parentheses are treated as separate argument tokens
